categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: toy business, game business, and football club business. The toy segment focuses on remote control car models, alloy car models, building block toys, infant toys, and outdoor riding products. The game segment develops and operates network games, specializing in ancient style strategy and idle games with multiple IP licenses. The football club segment manages the Spanish football club Espanyol, generating revenue from broadcasting rights, ticket sales, sponsorships, player transfers, and merchandise.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The toy business employs advanced R&D and manufacturing technologies including CAD, electronic digital technology, automotive-grade 3D printing, automated injection molding, ABB automated painting lines, UV printing, and semi-automatic silk-screening. The game business integrates AI technologies such as DeepSeek, ChatGPT, and AIGC for art design, content planning, code debugging, and marketing analytics. The football club utilizes AI models for sports management and talent identification. The company also adapts games for Huawei HarmonyOS and develops multi-platform products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The toy products are sold globally to retail chains like Toys 'R' Us, Smyths, Sam's Club, Amazon, Tmall, JD.com, and others, reaching over 120 countries and regions. The game business serves users in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and America, with a focus on mobile and mini-program games. The football club targets football fans worldwide, especially Spanish-speaking populations, and engages sponsors and media partners for commercial activities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters in Shantou and Guangzhou, and has significant overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Spain, Mexico, Japan, South Korea, and other countries. The football club business is centered in Spain with global fan engagement. The game business covers domestic and international markets including East Asia, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. The toy business exports to over 120 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It conducts end-to-end activities in toy manufacturing from R&D, production to sales. In gaming, it covers game development, publishing, and operation. The football club business involves sports management, marketing, and commercial exploitation of club assets. The company also engages in investment management as a separate segment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding product portfolios and market presence, deepening IP integration, and embracing AI technology across all business lines. R&D priorities include developing smart toys with AI voice interaction, multi-modal interaction, and cloud intelligence. In gaming, the company emphasizes long-life cycle games, IP-driven content, mini-program games, and AI-enhanced development. The football club aims to enhance brand influence and leverage AI for sports analytics and talent scouting.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales in the toy segment, including direct sales to retailers and e-commerce platforms. The game segment earns revenue via in-game purchases, licensing, and revenue sharing with operators. The football club business derives income from broadcasting rights, ticket sales, sponsorships, player transfers, and merchandise sales. Additional revenue comes from rental income and investment management activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the toy and interactive entertainment industry in China, with strong global IP partnerships and a diversified product portfolio. In gaming, it competes in niche strategy and idle game markets with recognized IPs and international presence. The football club business is unique as the first A-share listed company controlling a major European football club, positioning it distinctively in sports entertainment. Competitors include other toy manufacturers, game developers, and sports clubs with international reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, a 21.49% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 457.7 million. The toy business showed revenue growth of 20.28% and profit growth of 40.17%, while the game and football club segments experienced revenue declines and losses. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.79 billion and is undergoing a recovery phase with strategic cost control and market expansion plans.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation-driven product development, leveraging advanced technologies and strong IP collaborations to deliver differentiated, high-quality toys and games. Its toys feature intelligent interaction capabilities and authentic licensed designs from top automotive brands and international racing events. The game business offers culturally rich, IP-empowered games with long lifecycle and AI-enhanced user experiences. The football club business provides a unique cultural and commercial platform with deep-rooted heritage and global fan engagement, enhancing brand value and commercial opportunities.
